scope: Mac local Core online-first model discovery, configuration and typed media catalog
accepted_policy: Complete online list; provider-undeclared usage is labeled and may be saved for the current modality, then separately verified through inference.
behavior: Online IDs are authoritative and are not merged with local sample IDs or filtered by local model registration.
First read fetches when no matching connection snapshot exists; manual refresh replaces the successful scoped snapshot.
Provider-declared input/output modalities are preserved; OpenAI IDs without usage fields remain unspecified.
Unknown online IDs can be saved with an existing fixed modality driver template and explicit tenant profile.
The typed media catalog uses the same online IDs and keeps configuration, invocation grants and actual inference proof separate.
No catalog API declared for the connection mode: visibly local catalog. Authentication, network and upstream failures never silently fall back.
Refreshing or selecting does not send a generation request or alter another modality configuration.
